title: SurplusWithdrawer Configuration Mismatch Between Vault and YieldStrategy
description: The SurplusWithdrawer contract stores separate vault and yieldStrategy addresses but uses them inconsistently. The vault address is stored but never used in surplus calculations, leading to potential configuration mismatches.
rootCause: Stores separate vault and yieldStrategy addresses but uses inconsistently; vault address stored but never used in calculations
impact: Potential misconfiguration could lead to incorrect surplus calculation. If the vault and yieldStrategy become out of sync, surplus withdrawals may calculate incorrect amounts.
recommendation: Either remove the unused vault address storage or ensure both addresses are used consistently in all relevant calculations. Add validation to ensure vault and yieldStrategy configurations remain synchronized.
